Bringing corrected New York Times headlines right to their door. Headline correction by @assalrad_ . 

📍May 6th, 2025 at The NYT building 

There is video evidence of a zionist mob attacking women in Crown Heights following a pro-Palestine protest against war criminal Ben Gvir’s presence in New York City. Yet the NYT’s headline casts doubt on whether or not the assault occurred by saying the nypd is “investigating reports that 2 women were assaulted” & fails to name the perpetrators of the attack in order to shield them from accountability. 

Language matters. Accountability matters. Shame on The New York Times. #RetractYourLiesNYT
